title: Servicing Desk Guidance — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Late Charges and Their Waiver
content:
## Provisions in force

1. **Counting the grace days.** The grace days of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans installment are counted with the due date itself as day 0, so the charge first arises on the day after the last grace day.
2. **How the charge is booked.** A late charge is booked as a fee entry of the late-charge kind pointing to the installment bill it is charged on.
3. **Where no late charge applies.** No late charge applies to an installment deferred under the deferral terms, to fees, or while the loan is in nonaccrual status.
4. **Waiver for error correction.** A late charge is waived on the basis of error correction when a payment effective on or before the last grace day paid the installment in full.
5. **Courtesy waiver.** On the member's request a late charge may be waived on the basis of courtesy only when the installment has since been paid in full and the courtesy waivers granted on the loan in the rolling 12 months are below the product's courtesy waiver allowance.
6. **Extent of a waiver.** One waiver per fee assessment, for its unpaid amount.

## Grace-day count illustrated

Hypothetical product with a 15-day grace period, installment due on day 0:

| Day | Position | Late charge |
|---|---|---|
| Day 0 | the due date | does not arise |
| Day 15 | the last grace day | does not arise |
| Day 16 | the day after the last grace day | first arises |

## Waivers: conditions side by side

| Basis | When it is granted | Records it rests on |
|---|---|---|
| Error correction | a payment effective on or before the last grace day paid the installment in full | the payment's effective date and the installment bill |
| Courtesy | the member asks, the installment has since been paid in full, and courtesy waivers on the loan in the rolling 12 months are below the product's allowance | the installment bill's payments and the loan's earlier courtesy waivers |

Hypothetical: on a Used Equipment Loan, whose courtesy allowance is 1 in any rolling 12 months, a member whose loan received a courtesy waiver five months ago is at the allowance, so a second courtesy waiver is not available; on the EquipDirect Dealer Contract, whose allowance is 0, a courtesy waiver is never available.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of the original late-charge terms are no longer in force; each is superseded by the current basis for booking a late charge on an installment:

- "A late charge arises only after more than the product's late-charge grace period in calendar days has passed since the due date of the installment" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "Only one late charge may be assessed per installment." — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "It applies to an installment not paid in full by then (the amount paid on the installment below the installment due)" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "at the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid part of the installment, no less than the product's minimum late charge and no more than the product's maximum late charge, rounded to cents" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The product figures named in these terms — the late-charge percentage, the minimum and maximum late charge, the grace period and the courtesy waiver allowance — remain those of the product's servicing charges schedule.
